title: Saturation Dynamic
text: Limit input signal to dynamic upper and lower saturation values, 3 inputs, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Output data type} sets the output data type Inherit: Same as second; {Output minimum} sets the minimum output value for range checking, {Output maximum} sets the maximum output value for range checking, {Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools} sets the option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data, {Integer rounding mode} sets the rounding mode for fixed-point operations and {Saturate on integer overflow} sets the method of overflow action. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: up
ports.summary: Signal that provides the upper saturation limit scalar | vector

ports.name: lo
ports.summary: Signal that provides the lower saturation limit scalar | vector

params.name: Output minimum
params.values: Minimum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output maximum
params.values: Maximum output value for range checking [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Specify the output data type Inherit: Same as second input (default) | Inherit: Inherit via back propagation | double | single | int8 | int32 | uint32 | int64 | uint64 | fixdt(1,16,2^0,0) | |...

params.name: Lock output data type setting against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: Option to prevent fixed-point tools from overriding Output data type off (default) | on

params.name: Integer rounding mode
params.values: Specify the rounding mode for fixed-point operations Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: Method of overflow action off (default) | on
